rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something usually happens or is generally the rule.

example.english: I commonly take the bus to work.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 daap3 baa1 si2 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this when you mean ‘most of the time’ and want to emphasize the time pattern.

example.english: I commonly eat at home most of the time.
example.traditional: 多數時候我都喺屋企食飯。
example.jyutping: do1 sou3 si4 hau6 ngo5 dou1 hai2 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when commonly means ‘frequently’, especially when an action happens repeatedly.

example.english: They commonly forget to bring an umbrella.
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1

rows.note: Use this mainly when ‘commonly’ means generally or widely shared, rather than habitually usually.

example.english: This practice is commonly seen in the industry.
example.traditional: 呢種做法喺業界好普遍。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 zou6 faat3 hai2 jip6 gaai3 hou2 pou2 pin3
